summary: Iteration 8 - Comprehensive testing of invitation-based registration flow. All backend tests passed (13/13). Frontend UI tests passed. The flow correctly shows read-only Name, Email, Role, Company fields from invitation data and allows users to only set up password authentication.

minor.issue: Returns 404 for used tokens instead of a response with used=true. This causes frontend to show 'Invalid Invitation' instead of 'Invitation Already Used' message.

passed_tests: ✅ POST /api/invitations - creates staff invitation with token, email, role, expires_at
✅ POST /api/invitations - creates owner invitation correctly
✅ GET /api/invitations/validate/{token} - returns all required fields: email, role, company_name, first_name, last_name, phone, token, used
✅ GET /api/invitations/validate/{token} - returns 404 for invalid token
✅ GET /api/invitations/validate/{token} - pre-fills staff info (first_name, last_name, phone) from staff record when email matches
✅ POST /api/auth/register-with-invite - creates user with password, assigns role and company_id from invitation
✅ POST /api/auth/register-with-invite - marks invitation as used after registration
✅ POST /api/auth/register-with-invite - returns 404 for already-used token
✅ POST /api/auth/register-with-invite - returns 400 for email mismatch
✅ POST /api/auth/login - allows login with email/password after registration
✅ User created has correct role (staff), company_id, auth_method (password)
✅ POST /api/invitations - returns 400 for invalid role (not owner/staff)
✅ POST /api/invitations - returns 400 for duplicate pending invitation
✅ Frontend: Invite page shows read-only Name field (pre-filled or email prefix)
✅ Frontend: Invite page shows read-only Email field
✅ Frontend: Invite page shows read-only Role field ('Staff Member' or 'Property Owner')
✅ Frontend: Invite page shows read-only Company field
✅ Frontend: Info text 'These details are set by your organization and cannot be changed'
✅ Frontend: Google OAuth button present ('Continue with Google')
✅ Frontend: Password field with placeholder 'Min. 8 characters'
✅ Frontend: Confirm password field
✅ Frontend: Terms checkbox required before submission
✅ Frontend: 'Create Account' button disabled until terms accepted
✅ Frontend: Registration redirects to dashboard on success
✅ Frontend: Dashboard shows 'Hey, {FirstName}' greeting
✅ Frontend: Dashboard shows role-specific view (Staff Dashboard)
✅ Frontend: Invalid token shows 'Invalid Invitation' error with 'Go to Home' button
critical_code_review_comments: The invitation validation endpoint only searches for unused tokens, so used tokens return 404 instead of a distinct 'used' response. Frontend has 'Invitation Already Used' UI but never sees it.
Password validation (min 8 chars) is only on frontend - backend accepts any password length. Consider adding backend validation.
Pre-filling works correctly - staff records are queried by email to populate first_name, last_name, phone.
seed_data_creation: Created test admin user (admin.inv.{ts}@example.com) with company (comp_inv_{ts}). Created staff record (John Doe, uitest.prefilled@example.com) for pre-fill testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 8 verified the full invitation-based registration flow: (1) Admin creates invitation via POST /api/invitations, (2) Invited user visits /invite/{token}, (3) Page shows read-only Name/Email/Role/Company from invitation data + staff record lookup, (4) User only needs to enter password and accept terms, (5) Registration creates user with correct role/company_id, (6) User redirected to role-specific dashboard. Minor UX issue: used tokens show 'Invalid Invitation' instead of 'Invitation Already Used'.

invitation_creation.validation: Rejects invalid roles, duplicate pending emails

invitation_validation.pre_fill_logic: Looks up staff record by email for staff role, property record for owner role
